pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with jagged, stellate perimeters. Edges exhibit sharp pixel-level angularity rather than rounded gradients. The spatial area of individual patches is medium-to-large, with dark interior cores transitioning to lighter brown at the boundaries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous, high-connectivity network of wide, cream-colored pathways. Junction nodes primarily feature three-way intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways is substantial and relatively uniform across the visible mid-section.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous line of short, brown bristles creates a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette against the background along the upper neck and shoulder ridge.
